name: SYD OMEGA 91717 — Production Building Block Map
principle: Reuse the existing platform primitives first; introduce a new managed service only when an explicit scaling, isolation, compliance, or reliability requirement justifies it.

api-gateway.implementation: Supabase Edge Functions + explicit API boundary modules

load-balancer.implementation: Vercel edge routing for web traffic; provider-managed balancing for serverless/edge execution

microservices.implementation: Capability-oriented modules and Edge Functions; split only where independent scaling or ownership is justified

event-driven.implementation: Supabase database events/triggers plus asynchronous function boundaries; queue primitive added when workload requires durable buffering

database.implementation: Supabase PostgreSQL with migrations, RLS and schema contracts

caching.implementation: HTTP/CDN caching first; application cache only for measured hot paths

data-partitioning.implementation: PostgreSQL partitioning only for measured high-volume tables

object-blob-storage.implementation: Supabase Storage with private buckets, signed access and lifecycle policy

message-queues.implementation: Asynchronous Edge Function/event boundary; adopt Supabase Queues or equivalent managed queue when workload thresholds are met

fault-tolerance.implementation: Timeouts, bounded retries, idempotency, graceful degradation and provider isolation at every external boundary

cdn.implementation: Vercel edge/CDN delivery for static assets and cacheable public content

high-availability.implementation: Managed Vercel/Supabase availability primitives plus backup/restore and continuity procedures

observability.implementation: Structured browser/server logs, request correlation IDs, deployment checks and provider telemetry

security-identity.implementation: Supabase Auth/RLS, least privilege, secret isolation, security scanning and auditable authorization

ai-llm-gateway.implementation: Central AI policy boundary with model registry, routing, budget controls, safety/evaluation metadata and provider adapters

vector-search-rag.implementation: PostgreSQL/pgvector-compatible retrieval layer with provenance and permission-aware filtering
